current_evidence: The council's Application Checklists page links 'Validation Checklist V3.5 Final' (after a May 2026 consultation), and the document itself states Version 3.5, published 11.05.2026, effective 25.06.2026.

issues.detail: List date 2026-06-01 is taken from PDF metadata. The document states it was published 11 May 2026 and takes effect 25 June 2026.

Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the list has a full Householder section with local requirements: sections (sloping sites, level changes), street scene (roof notably higher or lower), photographs, CIL forms, BNG documents, Flood Risk Worksheet (FZ2/3), Flood Zone 3 assessment, ecology survey, tree assessment, D&AS (designated area or 100 sqm+), heritage statement, daylight/sunlight, noise, bat survey declaration and biodiversity checklist.

Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Works to trees, Lawful development cert, Change of use - prior approval and Permission in principle are all marked '(none)', but the list has a dedicated section for each with local requirements. Examples: LBC needs detail/section plans at 1:20-1:100, a heritage statement and internal and external photographs. Adverts need detailed sign drawings and a heritage statement in a CA or on a listed building. Tree works need tree identification by TPO number, photographs and qualified evidence. Prior approvals need a detailed written description and CIL Form 5. LDCs need evidence or sworn affidavits.

Requirements are mostly 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the source splits Full (non-major) from Major (10+ units / 0.5 ha). Several items placed under Full are Major-only or narrower. Air Quality Assessment, Archaeological Assessment, Contamination and Statement of Community Involvement appear only in the Major table. Health Impact Assessment is for 50+ unit residential schemes (Major), or for hot food takeaways in the Full section, not for full applications generally.
issues.evidence: Section 5 Major Development: 'Health Impact Assessment - Residential developments of 50+ units'; Section 4: HIA for sui generis hot food takeaways

issues.detail: Trigger excerpts are garbled from two-column table extraction. The text of adjacent rows is interleaved, e.g. the Air Quality trigger is cut off mid-sentence ('within or adjoining an Air mitigation measures'). The AIA trigger runs into the Health Impact Assessment text. The BNG and Design and Access Statement triggers are both a run of table headers ('Fee Calculator ... Correct Fee 18 back to CONTENTS ...') that says nothing about when they apply.
issues.evidence: Air Quality: 'Include housing and is within or adjoining an Air Quality Management Area'

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has a trigger excerpt that is actually the AIA/Health Impact Assessment text. The list has no 'schedule of works' requirement. LBC instead requires detail/section plans, a heritage statement and photographs.

'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is matched to the block plan drawing content (site access, parking, boundaries). The list has no visibility splay requirement. The related local items are the Parking Assessment and Transport Assessment.
issues.evidence: Site layout/block plan contents: 'Site access details ... Parking spaces Boundary treatments'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the source that are missing from Grokbot's rows: Bat survey declaration (any modification, conversion, extension or demolition of buildings), Biodiversity checklist and report (any potential biodiversity impact), Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (significant loss of light), Parking Assessment (changes to parking or departures from Essex Parking Guidance 2024; all majors), Refuse and Recycling details (homes 25m+ from highway, flats, commercial), Lighting Assessment (floodlighting; all majors), Energy Strategy (all majors), Affordable Housing Statement (10+ net units), Draft Travel Plan (ECC thresholds, 50+ employees, schools), Contamination Assessment (known or suspected contamination), Retail Assessment (main town centre uses out of centre), Statement of Community Involvement (all majors), Schedule of Development and Schedule of Plans and Documents, Essex SuDS proforma (all full and outline), Flood Risk Worksheet (householder FZ2/3), Sections and Street scene drawings, and CIL Forms 1/2.

The tab_items are only drawing-standard and submission guidance: common mistakes, file naming, the email-submission fallback, 'Fit to Page' advice and fragments with stray bullet characters. None of them is a requirement, and no actual local requirements were captured in tab_items.
issues.evidence: tab_items e.g. 'Name your files logically (e.g. "Proposed South Elevation.pdf"...)'; 'Submission via email to planning@castlepoint.gov.uk should only be used...'

issues.detail: 'Req. items' = 13 understates the list, which has around 60 distinct requirement-by-application-type entries across 11 sections.
issues.evidence: Contents: Householder, LDC, Prior Approvals, Full, Major, Change of Use, Outline, PiP, LBC, Tree Works, Advertisement

summary: Grokbot's link is the current V3.5 list (published 11 May 2026, effective 25 June 2026), but the extraction is poor. Householder, LBC, advert, tree, LDC, PiP and prior approval are all wrongly marked as having no local requirements. Many items are missing, Major-only items are lumped under Full planning, and the trigger excerpts are garbled.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
